pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso pavāsaṃ gacchanto pajāpatiṃ etadavoca suttaṃ dhārayitvā amukassa tantavāyassa dehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpetvā nikkhipāhi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.4: assosi kho aññataro piṇḍacāriko bhikkhu tassa purisassa imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.5: athakho so bhikkhu yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca mahāpuññosi tvaṃ āvuso upananda
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.6: amukasmiṃ okāse aññataro puriso pavāsaṃ gacchanto pajāpatiṃ etadavoca suttaṃ dhārayitvā amukassa tantavāyassa dehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpetvā nikkhipāhi āgato ayyaṃ upanandaṃ cīvarena acchādessāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.8: sopi kho tantavāyo āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.9: athakho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto yena so tantavāyo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ tantavāyaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.10: idaṃ kho āvuso cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa vīyati āyatañca karohi vitthatañca appitañca suvītañca suppavāyitañca suvilekhitañca suvitacchitañca karohīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.11: ete kho me bhante suttaṃ dhārayitvā adaṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.13: na bhante sakkā āyataṃ vā vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā kātuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.14: sakkā ca kho bhante suvītañca suppavāyitañca suvilekhitañca suvitacchitañca kātunti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.15: iṅgha tvaṃ āvuso āyatañca karohi vitthatañca appitañca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.17: athakho so tantavāyo yathāābhataṃ suttaṃ tante upanetvā yena sā itthī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca suttena ayye atthoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.18: nanu tvaṃ ayya mayā vutto iminā suttena cīvaraṃ vināhīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.19: saccāhaṃ ayye tayā vutto iminā suttena cīvaraṃ vināhīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.20: apica maṃ ayyo upanando evamāha iṅgha tvaṃ āvuso āyatañca karohi vitthatañca appitañca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.22: athakho sā itthī yattakaññeva suttaṃ paṭhamaṃ adāsi tattakaṃ pacchā adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.23: assosi kho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto so kira puriso pavāsato āgatoti. athakho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto yena tassa purisassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.24: athakho so puriso yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.25: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etadavoca vāyāpitaṃ cīvaranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.28: athakho sā itthī taṃ cīvaraṃ nīharitvā sāmikassa datvā etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.29: athakho so puriso āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa taṃ cīvaraṃ datvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.32: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyo upanando mayā pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.33: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa purisassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.34: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.35: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.36: athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.37: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.41: aññātako moghapurisa aññātakassa na jānāti paṭirūpaṃ vā appaṭirūpaṃ vā santaṃ vā asantaṃ vā
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.42: tattha nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pubbe appavārito aññātakassa gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.43: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.44: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.45.1: bhikkhuṃ paneva uddissa aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya. tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.46: idaṃ kho āvuso cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa vīyati āyatañca karotha vitthatañca appitañca suvītañca suppavāyitañca suvilekhitañca suvitacchitañca karotha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.48: evañca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattampi nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.2: bhikkhussatthāya bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā bhikkhuṃ acchādetukāmo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.4: mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.12: channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ vikappanupagaṃ pacchimaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.16: yaṃ bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaraṃ vīyati so bhikkhu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.18: pubbe avutto hoti kīdisena te bhante cīvarena attho kīdisaṃ te cīvaraṃ vāyāpemīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.22: idaṃ kho āvuso cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa vīyati āyatañca karotha vitthatañca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.23: appitañca suvītañca suppavāyitañca suvilekhitañca suvitacchitañca karotha
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.25: evañca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattampīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.27: yāgupi bhattaṃpi khādanīyaṃpi cuṇṇapiṇḍopi dantakaṭṭhaṃpi dasikasuttaṃpi antamaso dhammaṃpi bhaṇati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.28: tassa vacanena āyataṃ vā vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā karoti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.30: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.33: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ pubbe appavārito aññātakassa gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpannaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.38.1: aññātake aññātakasaññī pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjati nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.39: aññātake vematiko pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjati nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.40: aññātake ñātakasaññī pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṅkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjati nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
